affected.product: All in One Addons For WPBakery Page Builder  (formerly Visual Composer)

descriptions.value: The All in One Addons For WPBakery Page Builder  (formerly Visual Composer) WordPress plugin through 1.2 does not validate a shortcode attribute before using it to build a file path that is included and executed, which could allow users with the contributor role and above to include and execute arbitrary local PHP files on the server.

descriptions.description: CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

assertions.title: All in One Visual Composer Addons <= 1.2 - Contributor+ LFI via vca_tabs_style Shortcode Attribute

title: All in One Visual Composer Addons <= 1.2 - Contributor+ LFI via vca_tabs_style Shortcode Attribute
